::: {.custom-box}
To study convergence in $m$, we keep the spatial mesh size $h$ and time step $\tau$ fixed. Theorem `lastlasttheorem` in `paper/main.tex` gives
$$
E\lesssim\tau+h^{\alpha-\epsilon}
+h^{\alpha-2}\exp\!\left(-2\pi\sqrt{(1-\alpha/2)m}\right),
\qquad 0<\alpha<2.
$$
The rational contribution therefore has reference slope $S_m=-2\pi\sqrt{1-\alpha/2}$ in a regression of $\ln E$ against $\sqrt{m}$. This is an upper-bound prediction for that contribution, rather than a guaranteed slope of the total error. Temporal, spatial, and reference-quadrature errors can produce a plateau as $m$ increases; their sizes should be checked independently.
:::


```{r, eval = TRUE}
# remotes::install_github("davidbolin/rspde", ref = "devel")
# remotes::install_github("davidbolin/metricgraph", ref = "devel")
library(rSPDE)
library(MetricGraph)
library(grateful)

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(plotly)
library(slackr)
source("keys.R")
slackr_setup(token = token) # token comes from keys.R
```


```{r}
# Parameters
T_final <- 1e-4
kappa <- 4
divider <- 7
N_finite = 4 # choose even
adjusted_N_finite <- N_finite + N_finite/2 + 1
# Coefficients for u_0 and f
coeff_U_0 <- 50*(1:adjusted_N_finite)^-1
coeff_U_0[-5] <- 0
coeff_FF <- rep(0, adjusted_N_finite)
coeff_FF[7] <- 10

AAA = 1
OMEGA = pi

# Vary only the rational order; keep the spatial and temporal grids fixed.
m_vector <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
alpha_vector <- seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.4)
h_fixed <- 1e-4
time_step_target <- 1e-8
time_grid <- make_time_grid(T_final = T_final, target_step = time_step_target)
time_step <- time_grid$time_step
time_seq <- time_grid$time_seq
g_average <- average_sine_forcing(time_seq, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA)
```



```{r}
# Reference quadrature and error accumulation.
overkill_time_step <- 1e-8
overkill_h <- h_fixed / 2
error_n_blocks <- 10L
error_verbose <- TRUE

reference_grid <- make_time_grid(
  T_final = T_final, target_step = overkill_time_step
)
overkill_time_step <- reference_grid$time_step
overkill_time_seq <- reference_grid$time_seq
overkill_graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = overkill_h)
overkill_graph$compute_fem()
overkill_C <- overkill_graph$mesh$C

# The spatial discretization is fixed for every rational order and alpha.
graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = h_fixed)
graph$compute_fem()
C <- graph$mesh$C
L <- kappa^2 * C + graph$mesh$G
Psi <- graph$fem_basis(overkill_graph$get_mesh_locations())
stopifnot(all(coeff_U_0[-5] == 0))
U_0 <- project_u0_tadpole(graph, amplitude = coeff_U_0[5])
```


```{r, eval = FALSE, message = TRUE, class.source = "fold-show"}
# Create a matrix to store the errors
errors_projected <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(m_vector), ncol = length(alpha_vector))
for (j in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  alpha <- alpha_vector[j]
  beta <- alpha / 2

  # Reference eigenfunctions and rates; do not build the exact time history.
  overkill_eigen_params <- gets.eigen.params(
    N_finite = N_finite, kappa = kappa,
    alpha = alpha, graph = overkill_graph
  )
  EIGENVAL_ALPHA <- overkill_eigen_params$EIGENVAL_ALPHA
  overkill_EIGENFUN <- overkill_eigen_params$EIGENFUN
  active_modes <- which(coeff_U_0 != 0 | coeff_FF != 0)
  exact_basis <- overkill_EIGENFUN[, active_modes, drop = FALSE]
  exact_rates <- EIGENVAL_ALPHA[active_modes]
  exact_initial <- coeff_U_0[active_modes]
  exact_forcing <- coeff_FF[active_modes]

  exact_at_time <- function(t) {
    coefficients <- outer(
      seq_along(exact_rates), t,
      function(i, tt) {
        (exact_initial[i] + exact_forcing[i] * G_sin(
          t = tt, A = AAA,
          lambda_j_alpha_half = exact_rates[i], omega = OMEGA
        )) * exp(-exact_rates[i] * tt)
      }
    )
    exact_basis %*% coefficients
  }

  # The forcing is separated into one spatial load and temporal averages.
  spatial_modes <- t(Psi) %*% overkill_C %*% overkill_EIGENFUN
  spatial_load <- as.numeric(spatial_modes %*% coeff_FF)

  for (i in seq_along(m_vector)) {
    m <- m_vector[i]
    h <- h_fixed
    my_op_frac <- my.fractional.operators.frac(
      L = L, beta = beta, C = C,
      scale.factor = kappa^2, m = m, time_step = time_step
    )

    errors_projected[i,j] <- solve_fractional_evolution_error(
      my_op_frac = my_op_frac,
      time_step = time_step,
      time_seq = time_seq,
      val_at_0 = U_0,
      spatial_load = spatial_load,
      g_average = g_average,
      Psi = Psi,
      reference_C = overkill_C,
      reference_times = overkill_time_seq,
      exact_at_time = exact_at_time,
      n_blocks = error_n_blocks,
      verbose = error_verbose
    )
    slackr_msg(text = paste0("m =", m, ", alpha =", alpha, ", h =", h, ", time_step =", time_step), channel = "#research")
  }
}
save(errors_projected, file = here::here("data_files/errors_projected_m.RData"))
```


```{r}
load(here::here("data_files/errors_projected_m.RData"))
```


```{r}
observed_rates <- numeric(length(alpha_vector))
for (u in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  observed_rates[u] <- coef(lm(log(errors_projected[, u]) ~ sqrt(m_vector)))[2]
}

theoretical_rates <- -2 * pi * sqrt(1 - alpha_vector / 2)

p_m_tadpole <- error.convergence.plotter(x_axis_vector = m_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = exp_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = expression("Convergence in " * italic(m)),
                                 x_axis_label = expression(italic(m)),
                                 apply_sqrt = TRUE)

p_m_nicer_tadpole <- errorConvergencePlotterLatex(x_axis_vector = m_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = exp_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = "$\\mbox{Convergence in }m$",
                                 x_axis_label = "$m\\quad(\\sqrt{\\phantom{x}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 y_axis_label = "$\\|u-U_{h,m}^{\\tau}\\|_{L_2(\\Gamma\\times[0,T])}\\quad(\\log_{\\mathrm{e}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 color_label = "$\\quad\\quad\\;\\;\\alpha\\;|\\;\\phantom{-}\\mathtt{theo}\\;|\\;\\;\\phantom{-}\\mathtt{obs}\\;\\;|\\%\\mathtt{re}$",
                                 apply_sqrt = TRUE)

ggsave(here::here("data_files/conv_rates_m_tadpole.png"), width = 4, height = 5, plot = p_m_tadpole, dpi = 300)
myggsave(p_m_nicer_tadpole, width = 4, height = 5, use_mathpazo = TRUE)
save(p_m_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_m_tadpole.RData"))
save(p_m_nicer_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_m_nicer_tadpole.RData"))
```
